title: CSE 115A: Intro to Software Engineering
description: Introduction to software engineering principles, agile development, pair programming, automated testing, and team project delivery.

title: CSE 130: Principles of Computer Systems Design
description: Fundamental principles of computer systems design, concurrency, synchronization, caching, storage systems, and networking abstractions.

title: CSE 101: Introduction to Data Structures and Algorithms
description: Advanced data structures, graphs, balanced search trees, algorithm analysis, asymptotic notation, and proof techniques.

title: CSE 102: Introduction to Analysis of Algorithms
description: Methods for designing and analyzing algorithms including greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, divide-and-conquer, and NP-completeness.

title: CSE 120: Computer Architecture
description: Pipelined processors, instruction-level parallelism, caches, memory hierarchies, virtual memory, and hardware performance evaluation.

title: CSE 103: Computational Models
description: Theory of computation covering finite automata, regular languages, context-free grammars, Turing machines, decidability, and undecidability.

title: CSE 180: Database Systems I
description: Relational database model, SQL programming, relational algebra, schema normalization, index structures, and transaction concepts.

title: CSE 107: Probability and Statistics for Engineers
description: Introduction to probability and statistics for engineering applications: random variables, expectation, distributions, hypothesis testing, and Bayesian analysis.

title: CSE 13S: Computer Systems and C Programming
description: Introduction to systems programming using C, pointer manipulation, memory allocation, UNIX command-line development tools, and debuggers.

title: CSE 12: Computer Systems and Assembly Language
description: Introduction to computer hardware architecture, assembly language programming on RISC-V architectures, register operations, and stack conventions.

title: ECE 101: Introduction to Electronic Circuits
description: DC and AC circuit analysis, Kirchhoff's laws, Thevenin and Norton equivalents, operational amplifiers, and passive filter designs.

title: ECE 103: Signals and Systems
description: Continuous-time and discrete-time signals, linear time-invariant systems, Fourier series, Fourier transforms, Laplace transforms, and z-transforms.

title: ECE 118: Introduction to Mechatronics
description: Hands-on integration of mechanical, electrical, and computer engineering principles in autonomous embedded mechatronic systems.

title: ECE 151: Communications Systems
description: Analog and digital communication systems, modulation schemes (AM, FM, PSK, QAM), noise analysis, signal detection, and channel capacity.

title: MATH 19A: Calculus for Science, Engineering, and Mathematics
description: Differential calculus of single variable functions, limits, continuity, derivatives, optimization problems, and curve sketching.

title: MATH 19B: Calculus for Science, Engineering, and Mathematics
description: Integral calculus of single variable functions, fundamental theorem of calculus, integration techniques, applications to geometry and physics, and sequences and series.

title: MATH 21: Linear Algebra
description: Systems of linear equations, matrices, determinants, vector spaces, subspaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors.

title: MATH 23A: Vector Calculus
description: Multivariable functions, vectors in three-dimensional space, partial derivatives, directional derivatives, gradients, and multiple integrals.

title: AM 10: Mathematical Methods for Engineers I
description: Applications of linear algebra and differential equations to engineering systems, state-space representations, and numerical simulations.

title: ART 10F: 2D Design
description: Two-dimensional design fundamentals, composition, color theory, visual hierarchy, and hands-on studio work in contemporary visual media.

title: PHIL 11: Critical Thinking
description: Analysis of arguments, informal fallacies, deductive vs inductive reasoning, and critical evaluation of claims in media and public discourse.

title: FILM 80S: Special Topics in Film and Digital Media
description: Critical survey of digital media culture, cinematic storytelling techniques, narrative structure, and technological aesthetics.

title: HIS 10A: United States History to 1877
description: Survey of United States history from indigenous societies through colonial settlements, the American Revolution, Civil War, and Reconstruction.

title: ECON 1: Introductory Microeconomics
description: Economic analysis of market behavior, consumer decision-making, supply and demand, competitive markets, externalities, and public policy.

title: MUSC 11A: Introduction to Western Classical Music
description: Appreciation and listening analysis of Western classical music from medieval chant through Renaissance, Baroque, Classical, and Romantic eras.

title: ASTR 1: Introduction to the Cosmos
description: General survey of modern astronomy, stellar evolution, black holes, galactic structure, dark matter, and the cosmological history of the universe.

title: HAVC 30: Introduction to European Visual Culture
description: Visual culture, architecture, and painting in Europe from the Renaissance through the Enlightenment and modern period.
